style: Minimalist hand-drawn humour webcomic panel in a deliberately simple 'scribble' cartoon style: bold, thick black ink outlines like a soft felt-tip brush pen, slightly organic and alive but clean; large solid pure-black fills for hair, dark clothes and cast shadows; no hatching, no gradients, no shading, volume suggested only by the silhouette. Characters are simplified cartoons with big heads (about a third of their height), soft noodle-like arms and legs without visible joints, mitten hands and tiny feet; messy untamed hair with wild strands sticking out in every direction; large round, slightly vacant eyes with tiny pupils; very expressive broken or arched eyebrows; mouths reduced to a flat line, a lopsided smirk or a big round gasp; small pink blush marks on the cheeks. Exaggerated body language: slumped shoulders, dramatically rounded tired back, arms hanging limply, little anxious sweat drops next to the head. Very minimal setting: mostly empty off-white space with only one or two essential objects drawn in simple lines. Mostly black and white, with only one or two small flat muted accent colours used sparingly on a key object or garment, plus the pink cheeks. Looks drawn by hand, not digital.
constraints: A single illustration that fills the whole frame: one panel only, no panel borders, no frames, no gutters, no comic page layout, no white margins around the drawing (empty space inside the scene is fine). Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no writing on boards or signs, no speech bubbles, no captions, no logos. The upper quarter of the picture is plain empty background with no important detail.
